adversarial_question: Would I accept this as a valid capacity-reclamation baseline if I did not know the team wanted to build an FPGA?
adversarial_reasoning: The v5 call reached readiness, both stale-calibration sanity guards, and a bounded reclamation trigger, but the serving worker exited with status 1 immediately after that trigger. The controller safely aborted before a complete naive preservation, useful GPU1 capacity, queue recovery, restore, branch continuation, or v10 movement-accounting result existed. This is useful failure evidence, not a capacity-reclamation baseline.

settlement_audit.accounting_conclusion: The ledger charged the larger client-visible interval, kept actual and conservative consumption distinct, costed both at the recorded A100 rate, and cleared the v5 reservation.

further_retry_assessment.ceiling_capacity_conclusion: The current 12,600-A100-second ceiling can mathematically admit one additional 1,176-A100-second envelope and cannot admit two.
further_retry_assessment.authorization_reason: The v5 allocation was already the one narrowly justified retry following the v4 local control-plane failure. Remaining budget is necessary but not sufficient authority for a second retry; a new GPU allocation would require fresh explicit retry authorization plus a specific locally validated hypothesis for the serving-worker exit.
further_retry_assessment.recommended_action: Do not allocate again under the existing one-retry execution authorization. Preserve v5 diagnostics, identify the serving-worker failure locally, and request fresh authority only if another paid retry is desired.

cleanup_audit.evidence_method: read-only inspection of v5 controller cleanup state and postflight Modal CLI JSON evidence produced by the sole GPU coordinator; this reviewer did not invoke Modal

findings.finding: The v5 actual and conservative accounting are arithmetically consistent, separately labelled, uniquely settled, and below both the cumulative A100-time and USD ceilings.
The v5 app is stopped; tasks, containers, endpoints, provider and ledger reservations, child processes, compute processes, and profilers are zero; only the two authorized volumes remain.

The integrated transaction failed after the reclaim trigger and before the required preservation, recovered-capacity, queue-drain, restore, correctness, and movement gates. No v10 naive capacity-reclamation baseline may be frozen or tagged from v5.
findings.required_resolution: Report scientific validity as false and all uncompleted transaction metrics as NOT MEASURED. Preserve the diagnostic artifacts without substituting historical v9 values.

findings.finding: Although one 1,176-A100-second envelope fits beneath the current ceiling, the already-consumed one-retry execution authorization does not automatically authorize another paid allocation.
findings.required_resolution: Require fresh explicit retry authority and a specific locally tested serving-worker failure hypothesis before any further Modal launch.
